stories.headline: Claude Opus 5.5 debuts with lower costs

stories.headline: Google opens Project Suncatcher test
stories.summary: On 2026-09-24, Google said Project Suncatcher will begin a first orbital test of TPU hardware for future AI compute in space.
stories.why_it_matters: A bold new compute path that could reshape AI infrastructure.

stories.headline: Google adds AI to YouTube ads
